Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Shikhar Dhawan and Shubman Gill will open the batting for India. Alzarri Joseph will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is similar to what West Indies had to chase in the last game. The hosts failed but can the visitors get over the line? They do have the batting. The wicket is also a decent one, there is some hold in it but still a good one to bat on. Windies on the other hand, will know if they bowl well, this can be defended. Join us for the chase!

Shai Hope is down for a chat! He says that getting a 100 on his 100th game means a lot to him. Adds that it was tough getting there as his back was getting to him, he was facing some issues. Mentions that he is pretty pleased with the target they have set. Further says that he needed some time in the middle which he got in this game and he is happy to capitalize on that.

For India, Yuzvendra Chahal was not at his best, and usually, when he has an off day, India struggles with the ball. Avesh Khan also did not have a day to remember. The likes of Mohammed Siraj, Deepak Hooda, and Axar Patel had decent figures though but India will be slightly disappointed with their bowling effort.

It was the top three which laid the foundation for the hosts. The good work was then continued by Nicholas Pooran and Shai Hope. That was the stand that turned the game in the hosts’ favor as they added over 100. Pooran fell but Hope continued. He got to a ton and played a major role in getting his side over the 300-run mark.

West Indies have batted themselves to a really good total but against a strong Indian batting line-up, one is never sure what is enough but this will take some chasing, Windies will believe they are favourites at the moment and their decision of batting first has been justified.
Fuller one, wide of off again. Akeal Hosein throws his bat at it but he misses. West Indies end at 311 for 6!
SIX! Bang! On a length and on the pads. Akeal Hosein flicks it high over deep square leg for a biggie!
Yorker now, outside off. Akeal Hosein fails to dig this one out.

Full again, down the leg side. Romario Shepherd looks to heave this but he misses. The ball hits his pads goes towards the keeper. Sanju Samson fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters cross ends for a single.

Bye! Sloopy work from Mohammed Siraj! A fuller one, outside off. Akeal Hosein looks to drive this but he misses. Sanju Samson collects the ball and throws it back to the bowler. Mohammed Siraj fumbles there to grab the ball and the batters sneak in a bye in return!

Two wides! Too short on this occasion, around middle, slower as well. Romario Shepherd misses his hook shot once again. Wide called for height! Sanju Samson fumbles to grab the ball as well and the batters sneak in a bye.
Swing and a miss! Shorter one, around off. Romario Shepherd looks to pull this one but he gets beaten.
Very full again, outside off. Romario Shepherd slices it towards deep point for a single. He retains the strike!

OUT! TAKEN! Shardul Thakur strikes once again and gets rid of Shai Hope! Shardul Thakur might be expensive here but he has a knack for picking up wickets!  A wonderful knock from Hope comes to an end. This was fuller and outside off. Shai Hope lifts it high towards deep extra cover. Axar Patel there takes a good catch. He walks off to a standing ovation! Akeal Hosein is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Axar Patel b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one, outside off. Shai Hope drives it square of the wicket on the off side and takes a couple of runs. That brings up the 300 for West Indies!

TWO WIDES! Shardul Thakur errs in line as he serves it way down the leg side, fuller. Romario Shepherd leaves it alone. Wide called! The batters scamper across to sneak in a bye as well. Sanju Samson throws the ball towards Shardul Thakur who collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. But the reply shows that Shai Hope's bat has just made it in.
A yorker now, outside off. Shai Hope squeezes it out towards cover for a quick single.
Another low full toss, around off. Romario Shepherd walks across and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss and outside off. Shai Hope drives it uppishly and just over Shikhar Dhawan at cover. Single taken!
Back of a length, down the leg side. Romario Shepherd miscues his pull shot towards deep square leg for a brace.
Swing and a miss again! Outside off now, on a length. Romario Shepherd looks to slash this one but he fails to get any bat on it.
Drops it short now, around middle. Romario Shepherd looks to pull this but he misses.
FOUR! Crunched! Pitches it up, around the leg pole. Romario Shepherd steps down the pitch and whips it in the gat between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Mohammed Siraj takes the pace off and serves a short one, outside off. Shai Hope looks to pull this but the ball goes off his toe end towards point. Another single is taken!
A low full toss and outside off. Romario Shepherd opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point for a single.
On a length and on off, Romario Shepherd punches it towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Short ball around the fourth stump line. Shepherd on the back foot keeps this pull down as he swivels. The ball clears the square leg fence for a boundary.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rovman Powell's cameo comes to an end. Outside off and full in length, Rovman Powell hits it hard towards long off. The ball goes flat and straight towards Shreyas Iyer who takes a good catch to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Romario Shepherd makes his way out to the middle.
Goes wide outside off, Rovman Powell looks to play at it but misses. Wide called.
A low full toss, Rovman Powell hits it hard but the ball hits the stumps of the non-striker's end.
SIX! This is well connected from Rovman Powell. On a length and on off, Rovman Powell stands firm and slams it over long on for a maximum.
Fuller and on off, Shai Hope guides it towards point for one.
Fuller and on middle, Shai Hope eases it towards long off for one.
Shorter one on middle, Rovman Powell ducks underneath it. The keeper fails to collect it. Leg bye taken.
On off, defended out.
FOUR! Wayward full toss outside leg, Rovman Powell just gives a fine tickle as the ball races the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shorter one on off, Shai Hope looks to pull it but gets a bottom edge as the ball rolls towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
On a length and on middle, Rovman Powell plays it towards the left of mid on and takes a single.
A dot to end! The damage though was done earlier on. Outside off, this one is pushed through. Hope misses as he looks to drive.

SIX! BANG! Over the cover fence. That is a beauty of a stroke! This is floated up outside off, Hope lifts it over the cover fence for another big one. Chahal has gone for plenty in this game. He is under massive pressure now.

SIX! That is a massive hit! Hope gets his ton up in style! He is mighty pleased about it. A really good innings and well-deserved. He was short of runs and he scores a ton in his 100th ODI game. Steps out now, gets to the pitch of it and tonks it over the long off fence for a biggie.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Singles won't harm the Indians.
WIDE! Slows it up and bowls it well wide outside off, left alone. Wided.
Flatter and on middle, this one is pushed through. Defended.
Just the one! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Yuzvendra Chahal (8-0-54-1) is back on!
On a length and outside off, Shai Hope looks to play at it but gets a thick inside edge as the ball rolls towards backward square leg. A single taken.
Goes outside off, Rovman Powell guides it towards backward point for one.
Rovman Powell walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Pooran has been bowled around his legs! This is just what Thakur was looking for, he got dispatched for a boundary on the previous ball but this time gets it on the spot on and he enjoys it. Big wicket too as Pooran was in his elements. This could well be the difference of Windies finishing with 320 and below that. This is full and on the leg stump. Pooran like he has been doing, shuffles across again. He looks to whip it but misses and the ball hits the leg pole. A really good innings from Pooran but his side would have loved for him to stay till the end.
FOUR! Whipped away wonderfully! Pooran moves across and Thakur goes full and on the pads, this is whipped past the backward square leg fielder and into the fence.
Shorter and outside off, Nicholas Pooran looks to play at it but misses. Wide called.
Misfield makes the two easy! Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point. The call is for two, they go for it, the fielder fumbles and the two is made easy.
Good delivery! Full and outside off, Pooran jams it out to point. Dots are gold at this stage!
Outside off this time, Nicholas Pooran hops a bit and awkwardly slaps it towards point and takes a single.
Shorter one and outside off, Nicholas Pooran gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end.
Short and outside off. Nicholas Pooran cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point.
SIX! This is a well-timed shot from Nicholas Pooran. Fuller one on leg, Nicholas Pooran uses the pace of the ball and flicks it over fine leg for a maximum.
On a length around off. Hope stands tall and punches it away towards deep cover-point and rotates the strike.
Fuller and on middle, Nicholas Pooran looks to loft it but doesn't connect well. The ball was in the air for some time but falls in no man's land towards long on. They cross.
Outside off and fuller, Nicholas Pooran guides it towards third man for one.
Another length delivery, this is a slower one outside off Shai Hope guides it towards the deep third man region and a single has been taken. The 100 partnership is up between Pooran and Hope now!
On off this time, Shai Hope guides it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller one n middle, Shai Hope flicks it towards deep square leg where the fielder collects it but loses his balance. They take a couple of runs.
On off and on a good length, Nicholas Pooran drives it towards extra covers and rotates the strike.
On a length and on off, Nicholas Pooran looks to play at it but misses.
Fuller one again, Hope defends it back towards Axar Patel.
Fuller one on leg, Shai Hope defends it towards the vacant short leg region.
Goes outside off, this is played towards the fielder at covers.
On middle, this is flicked towards mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Flatter one on middle, Nicholas Pooran gets on his knees and lofts it over bowler's head for a maximum.
Flatter one on off, this is eased towards covers for one.
Time for Powerplay 3! India are now allowed to keep 5 fielders outside the inner circle. Also, Axar Patel comes back into the attack.
Back of a length and on off, Nicholas Pooran opens the face of his bat and eases it towards backward point.
Fuller one again, this is pushed towards long on for a single.
Fractionally fuller this time and outside off, Hope takes a step forward and pushes this straight to the cover fielder.
On a length and on middle, this is defended out solidly.
Slightly shorter one, Nicholas Pooran pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Bowls it outside off, Nicholas Pooran dances down the track and swings his bat but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounces towards the keeper.
50 up for Nicholas Pooran. A low full toss, Nicholas Pooran pushes it to long off for one. It's been an exceptional knock from him so far, but he will want to go on till the end.
SIX! Goes wide outside off, Nicholas Pooran steps down the pitch, fetches it from outside off, and smashes it over long off for a biggie again! He moves to 49 now.
Outside off this time, Nicholas Pooran eases it towards the cover fielder.
SIX! Tossed up on middle, Nicholas Pooran uses his feet and smashes it over long on for a maximum. He moves to 43 now.
On off, this is eases towards covers for one.
Tosses it on middle with a hint of turn, Shai Hope steers it towards point and straight towards the fielder.
Serves a fuller one this time, Nicholas Pooran looks to drive it but misses as the ball goes towards the keeper.
Slightly shorter one, Shai Hope punches it towards point and takes one.
Sticks to his line bowling it outside off, Shai Hope hits it but finds the fielder at point.
Outside off this time, Nicholas Pooran eases it towards backward point for one.
Delivers a shorter one on middle, Nicholas Pooran looks to pull it but misses.
Bowls it outside off again, Nicholas Pooran looks to slap it but misses. Oh, its a no ball. Free Hit coming up!
Starts with a length ball outside off, Shai Hope cuts it towards point for one.
Shardul Thakur comes back to bowl. He went for 13 runs in his first over!
On off, defended away.
Fuller one on middle, Nicholas Pooran swings it but doesn't connect well. The ball rolls towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length and on middle, Hope on the back foot tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter one this time, Nicholas Pooran uses his feet and hits it hard but finds the fielder at long on. Single taken.
On off, Shai Hope hits it towards point where Shardul Thakur stops it diving to his left. They take a single.
Fuller one on off, Nicholas Pooran eases it towards long on for one.
Slightly shorter one on off, Nicholas Pooran looks to block it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball rolls towards the third man. They cross.
Bowls it outside off, Nicholas Pooran looks to play at it but misses.
This one lands down the leg side, Shai Hope flicks it towards short fine leg and rotates the strike.
Flicks a fuller ball towards mid on for a single.
On a length and down the middle, this is defended solidly off the front foot.
Touch fuller and on off, Nicholas Pooran flicks it but finds the fielder at mid on.
Slightly shorter one, Nicholas Pooran waits for the ball and punches it towards long on for one.
Goes fuller again, Nicholas Pooran drives it through covers for a brace.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Nicholas Pooran defends it back towards the bowler.
Length ball and on off, Pooran clears his front leg and chops it towards cover-point region.
SIX! Goes flatter and on middle, Nicholas Pooran dances down the track and smashes it over long on for a maximum.
Yuzvendra Chahal bowls a flatter one outside leg, Nicholas Pooran looks to sweep it but misses.
A dot to end then! Fuller and on middle, this is jammed out to mid off.
Siraj goes full again and on middle, this is clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this is worked down to fine leg.
That was a very risky run! On off, this is pushed to mid on and Pooran takes off. The fielder runs in, picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length and on off, this is kept out.
Two more! On middle, very full, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.

DRINKS! After losing two quick wickets, West Indies once again have started scoring runs freely. Nicholas Pooran and Shai Hope have put together an unbeaten stand of 47 so far. They will be aiming to go on till the end and help their team to get over the 300-run mark. While India continues to look for wickets. A few quick wickets from here and they can shift the momentum towards them. A crucial passage of play coming up! Also, Mohammed Siraj comes back into the attack.
Close! The slider, on middle, Hope plays a little outside the line, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Gives it air and lands it on off, this is pushed to cover.
Playing Chahal watchfully! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Two dots in a row! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Nicely flighted, lands it on off, kept out.
Tossed up outside off, Hope strokes it through covers for one.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes back to bowl!
A biggie and a couple of singles from the over. Decent one despite going for a biggie from Hooda. On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Yet another dot! On middle, Pooran plays it back to the bowler.
Hooda now fires this one in on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
SIX! That is a serious shot! Excellent use of the feet, gets to the pitch of it and creams it over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
A dot to end a tidy over from Patel! On the stumps, it is pushed to cover.
Fires it on middle, defended.
Slightly shorter, this grips in the surface a touch. Pooran looks to pull, it goes off the underedge down to fine leg for one.
Well bowled! Sees the batter step out and fires it onto the pads. Pooran swings but misses to get hit on the pads.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tosses it up this time, full and outside off. Nicholas Pooran drives it towards cover.
Quicker this time, attacking the stumps, shortish ball. Shai Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length, around middle, spinning in. Shai Hope uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Outside off this time, short again. Nicholas Pooran cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Pulls his length back now, serves a shorter one, around middle and leg. Shai Hope pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it up, around middle. Nicholas Pooran dances down the pitch and pushes it towards long off for a single.
Much fuller now, outside off. Shai Hope defends it towards point.
Down the leg side, fuller one. Nicholas Pooran sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter this time, spinning in, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran clips this one to the fielder at mimd-wicket.
Fuller one, around middle and off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out.
An arm ball, around middle, short as well. Shai Hope pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, outside off, spinning away. Shai Hope punches it off the back foot past point for a boundary. Shardul Thakur runs to his left, and dives but he fails to stop the ball. Good effort from though!
Turn and bounce! Slightly short, this one lands around off and spins away. Nicholas Pooran gets beaten while trying to defend this one.
Fuller one, spinning away, around off. Nicholas Pooran leans forward and blocks it out.
Tosses it up, full delivery, around middle and off. Shai Hope sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back to over the wicket a fuller one, around middle. Shai Hope pushes it back to the bowler.
Deepak Hooda goes 'round the wicket now serves a fuller one, around middle. Nicholas Pooran drives it towards long off for a single.
Spinning in, around middle and leg, shorter one. Shai Hope tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Shorter one, around off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
On a length now, outside off. Shai Hope taps it towards third man and takes a single.
Sticks to his length and serves a short one, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
Back of a length again, outside off. Shai Hope dabs it towards third man for a single.
Shorter one again, outside off. Shai Hope looks to cut this one but the ball goes off the inside edge towards the keeper.
Tad shorter, outside off. Shai Hope pushes it off the back foot towards the fielder at cover.
Outside off, short again. Shai Hope pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Fuller now, around off. Shai Hope leans to drive this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Turn and bounce there! A shorter one, outside off, spinning away. Shai Hope looks to play this one but he bails out in the end.
Full and much straighter this time. Shai Hope pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran advances down the pitch and drives it down the ground for a single.
On a length, around off. Shai Hope defends it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran taps it off the back foot towards mid off and takes a single.
Good ball again! Another length ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to have a poke at this one but he gets beaten.
Swing and a miss! On a length shaping away, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to cut this but he misses.
Full now, around off. Shai Hope drives it towards mid off and takes a single.
FOUR! Oh, glorious! On a length, around off. Shai Hope shows the full face of the bat and drives it elegantly through mid off for a boundary.

Two Byes! Oh, well bowled! A fuller ball, quicker, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leans to block this one but he gets beaten on the inside edge. Sanju Samson too fails to grab the ball. It rolls away towards fine leg and the batters takes two byes!
Short now, spinning away from the right-hander, outside off. Shai Hope taps it wide of cover and takes a single.
Quicker, shorter, around middle. Nicholas Pooran looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Much fuller now, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran leans forward and turns it away from the fielder at short leg.
Another short delivery, turning in, around off. Nicholas Pooran covers the line of the ball and defends it out.
Back of a length, spinning in, around off. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and blocks it out.
Shorter on, around middle. Nicholas Pooran stays in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two overs for India! This is just what they needed! West Indies are now 3 down. A loopy ball, full. This one lands around middle, and spins away a tad. Brandon King gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but the ball goes off the top edge and lobs up behind the keeper. Shikhar Dhawan from first slip runs towards the ball and grabs it safely. Brandon King departs without troubling the scorers.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Full, around middle and off. Brandon King leans forward and defends it out.
Loopy one, slower through the air, full and around off. Shai Hope knocks it towards long off. Single taken!
Tosses it up, full and on the pads. Shai Hope flicks it towards fine leg for a brace.
Back of a length, around middle. Shai Hope pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter this time, around middle. Brandon King stays in his crease and defends it out. A wicket-maiden over from Axar Patel!
Full, and on the stumps. Brandon King blocks it out.
Full and around off. Brandon King drives it towards cover.
Brandon King walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Axar Patel strikes and provided the breakthrough! He gets rid of a well-settled Shamarh Brooks! A shorter one, it lands around middle and turns away a tad. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and looks to block this one but the ball goes off the outside edge and goes towards first slip. Shikhar Dhawan there takes a good catch towards his left. Excellent captaincy from him to keep a slip as well!
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards the right of the bowler. Axar Patel dives and makes a goo stop.
Lopy ball, full and around off. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.
Tosses it up, full and around off. Shai Hope drives it back to the bowler.

SIX! BANG! Shai Hope brings his fifty in style! A loopy ball, full and around off. Shai Hope gets down on his knee and sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! A 50 in his 100th ODI! He will want to convert this one.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks knocks it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! A fuller one, another leg-break, around middle. Shamarh Brooks heaves it over mid-wicket for a lovely boundary.
A leg-break, shorter one, and outside off. Shamarh Brooks punches it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Quicker and on middle. Shai Hope taps it towards cover and takes a single.
Full and around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks sweeps and finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Full and on the pads. Shai Hope clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Pulls his length further back, and serves it outside off. Shai Hope punches it off the back foot through cover for a brace.
Spinning in, shorter one, around the pads. Shai Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off. Shai Hope leans forward and blocks it out.
Flatter one, shortish and around middle. Shai Hope pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Quicker, tad shorter and outside off. Shamarh Brooks waits for it and cuts it past point for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, full again, around middle. Shai Hope drives it down to long on. Single taken!
Loopy ball, full and around off. Shai Hope defends it out.
Pitches it up, full and outside off. Shai Hope drives it towards extra-cover.
Tosses it up, very full, around off. Shai Hope pushes it back to the bowler.
Quick, short and outside off. Shai Hope cuts it towards point. Mohammed Siraj dives to his right and makes an excellent stop!
Short again, spinning in, around off. Shamarh Brooks punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Back of a length, turning in, around off. Shamarh Brooks rocks back and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller this time, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks flicks it away towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Too short this time, spinning in, around middle. Shamarh Brooks uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter one, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks steps down the wicket and blocks it out.
On the pads, full in length. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards square leg.
Pitches it up, and on the pads this time. Shamarh Brooks pushes it down to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, full and around off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Tosses it up, fuller one now, around off. Shamarh Brooks drives it back to the bowler.
Shorter this time, around off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out off the back foot.
Another loopy one, full again, around off. Shai Hope drives it to long off for a single. 100 up for West Indies!
Yuzvendra Chahal begins with a loopy ball, very full, around middle. Shai Hope pushes it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! West Indies are cruising along nicely so far! They have lost one wicket, but they are rotating the strike well, hitting the bad balls, and keeping the scoreboard ticking. Shai Hope on his 100th ODI is looking well-stelled at the moment. India will need quick wickets to take things under control. Having said that, Yuzvendra Chahal one of their best bowlers comes into the attack. Can he get a breakthrough for India?
Very full this time, around middle. Shai Hope pushes it towards long on for a single.
Full again, on the pads now. Shamarh Brooks clips it towards square leg for a run.
Fuller, and around middle. Shai Hope knocks it towards long on.
Another one around middle and leg, shortish ball. Shamarh Brooks works it away towards square leg for a single.
Turning it in, around middle. Shai Hope flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Full and around off. Shai Hope drives it towards cover.
Outside off, fuller one. Shai Hope drives it towards point. Single taken!
Spinning away, short one, and outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper.
Pitches it up now, outside off. Shamarh Brooks opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
Shorter one, around middle. Shamarh Brooks clips it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks stays in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Quicker, full and outside off. Shai Hope leans to drive but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Shai Hope flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy one, full as well, around off. Shai Hope presses forward and blocks it out.
Pitches it up, around middle and off. Shai Hope leans forward and turns it away to mid-wicket.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Shai Hope flicks it towards square leg.
Outside off, tosses it up, full again. Shai Hope blocks it out.
full, spinning in, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Short again, around middle and off. Shai Hope defends it out.
Short now, around off. Shai Hope stays in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full this time, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Shai Hope pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly placed! Quicker, and outside off, slightly short. Shai Hope drives it through backward point for a boundary.
Quicker at 94 clicks, shorter one, and outside off. Shai Hope pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Fuller ball, quicker and on the pads. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards square leg.
Pitches it up again, spinning in, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks leans forward and taps it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and around middle and off. Shai Hope drives it wide of long on. Only a single.
Flatter, shorter and on the pads. Shai Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards long on. Single taken!
Tad quicker, fuller in length, outside off. Shai Hope leans to drive but he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks flicks it off the back foot through square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter one now, outside off. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
Full and outside, A bit of extra bounce there as well. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards point.
Loopy one, full and on middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
Another fuller delivery, outside off. Shai Hope strides forward and drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Axar Patel tosses it up, full, around off. Shai Hope presses forward and blocks it out.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over!
Shorter one, spinning in, around middle. Shai Hope knocks it towards long on for a single.
Slower now, on middle, full in length. Shai Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller now, around middle. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Shamarh Brooks is off the mark in style! A loopy ball, outside off, short as well. Shamarh Brooks uses the depth of his crease and cuts it past point for a boundary.
A fuller one, tosses it up, around off. Shamarh Brooks drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Shamarh Brooks is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Deepak Hooda strikes on his very first delivery! He draws first blood and sends Kyle Mayers back to the hut. What a decision to bring Deepak Hooda into the attack! He serves a fuller one, around middle from 'round the wicket. Kyle Mayers leans to drive this but ends up chipping in back to the bowler. Deepak Hooda gets low and takes a good catch.
Deepak Hooda is brought into the attack!
Ends the over with a shorter ball now, around off, at 136 clicks. Shai Hope ducks under it and leaves it alone.
Mohammed Siraj serves it on a length again, around the pads this time, at 140 clicks. Kyle Mayers tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope dabs it towards backward point and takes a single this time.
On a length now, around off. Shai Hope taps it towards point. No run there!
Back of a length, outside off. Shai Hope cuts it towards backward point.
Good-length delivery, tailing in, around middle. Shai Hope blocks it out towards the leg side.
A full toss, outside off. Kyle Mayers drives that firmly through point. Yuzvendra Chahal in the deep runs to his right, dives, and makes a good stop. Two taken!
Leg bye! Angling in now, on a length, on the pads. Shai Hope misses his flick and the ball hits his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Another length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Kyle Mayers dabs it towards point and takes a single.

SIX! BANG! Runs are flowing for West Indies! Shardul Thakur goes 'round the wicket now, and serves a fuller one, outside off. Kyle Mayers slams this one over cover all the way for a biggie! First one of the innings!

FOUR! Kyle Mayers greets Shardul Thakur with a boundary! He begins with a fuller one, outside off. Kyle Mayers drives it through point. Mohammed Siraj runs to his left, and dives but he fails to stop the ball. 50 up for West Indies!
Shardul Thakur comes into the attack!
Shorter one, outside off. Shai Hope leaves it alone.
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Shai Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good stop! Fuller one, around off. Shai Hope drives it straight down the ground. Mohammed Siraj gets his right hand down and makes a good stop there!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around middle. Shai Hope ducks underneath it. Wide called for height!
Mohammed Siraj drops it short, around middle. Kyle Mayers swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg. Axar Patel there does well to stop the ball. Single taken!
On a length, outside off. Shai Hope dabs it down towards third man for a single.
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Kyle Mayers works it away towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Smart shot! Shorter one, outside off. Shai Hope hops and guides it down toward third man for a boundary. Third boundary in the over! Another expensive one from Avesh Khan!
Shorter one, on the body. Kyle Mayers miscues his pull shot over square leg for a single.
This one tails back in a tad, on a length, outside off. Kyle Mayers gets beaten on the inside edge this time.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Avesh Khan goes 'round the wicket, serves a fuller one, width on offer there as well. Kyle Mayers lunges forward and drives it away from his body through cover for a boundary. That was driven powerfully!
FOUR! A gift to Kyle Mayers! A low full toss, much slower in pace, at 118 clicks. Kyle Mayers presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.

Angling in, fuller length, around middle and leg. Shai Hope flicks it past the diving fielder at mid on. Mohammed Siraj chases the ball, slides and keeps the ball away from the boundary ropes. Three runs taken!
Swinging in, on a length, around middle and leg. Shai Hope flicks it towards square leg and takes a single. He retains the strike!
Well bowled! Mohammed Siraj hits the deck hard now, and serves a short one, around middle. Shai Hope ducks under that one.
Angling in this time, tad fuller, around middle and leg. Shai Hope pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter one, outside off, at 141 clicks. Shai Hope lets that go through to the keeper.
Full again, around off. Shai Hope drives it again but finds the fielder at mid off this time.

FOUR! Oh, glorious! Pitches it up, outside off. Shai Hope leans into it, shows the full face of the bat, and drives it past mid off for a beautiful boundary. Three boundaries in a row for West Indies!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is even better! Fuller one now, outside off. Kyle Mayers drives it uppishly over cover for another boundary. 13 runs off the over!
FOUR! Crunched! On a length, around middle. Kyle Mayers pulls this through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Quick single! Fuller one, around middle and off. Shai Hope pushes it off the front foot towards mid off and scampers across to the other end.
Oh, lovely delivery! Avesh Khan surprises Shai Hope with a short ball this time. He serves it outside off, at 143 clicks. Shai Hope sways away from it.
Fuller again, wide of off. Shai Hope drives this one away from his body but finds the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! A half-volley, outside off. Shai Hope lunges forward, opens the face of his bat, and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Another shorter ball, around off. Kyle Mayers looks to push this through cover but he gets an inside edge back onto his pads. A maiden over from Mohammed Siraj!
Back of a length, outside off, hint of away movement there again. Kyle Mayers stays in his crease and looks to have a poke at it but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length now, around off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards mid off.
Play and a miss! Well bowled! Fuller again, wide of off, at 137 clicks. Kyle Mayers presses forward to drive this one away from his body but he misses as the ball swings away from him.
Pitches it up again, around middle, at 138 clicks. Kyle Mayers shows the full face of the bat and drives it towards mid on.

A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! A fuller ball, swinging into the left-hander, around the leg pole. Kyle Mayers looks to flick this one but the ball hits him on his pads first and then goes on to hit the bat. India opts for a review! The Ball Tracking indicates that it was pitching outside leg. The on-field decision stands and India loses a review here!
On a length, darting it on the thigh pad. Kyle Mayers tucks it towards fine leg for a single. 7 runs off Avesh Khan's first over in ODI cricket.
FOUR! Lovely shot! On a length, outside off. Kyle Mayers leans forward and drives it through cover for a glorious boundary.
Quick single! Full, around middle and off. Shai Hope closes the face of the bat and pushes it down the ground for a single.
Tad fuller, outside off. Shai Hope opens the face of the bat and drives it to the fielder at cover-point.
Well bowled! On a length now, shaping away, outside off. Shai Hope lunges forward and gets beaten while trying to drive this one.
Avesh Khan begins with a fuller ball, swinging in, around middle. Kyle Mayers looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Avesh Khan the debutant will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! West Indies and Shai Hope are up and running in style! Slightly shorter, outside off, at 133 clicks. Shai Hope stands tall and punches it off the back foot though cover for a boundary.
Pitches it up now, around the off pole, at 136 clicks. Shai Hope pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
On a length, outside off. Shai Hope presses forward and leaves it alone.
Swing and a miss! Much fuller now, hint of away movement as well, outside off, at 133 clicks. Shai Hope leans to drive this but he misses.
Another good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Shai Hope lets that go through to the keeper.
Mohammed Siraj begins with a length ball, swinging away, outside off. Shai Hope leaves it alone.

We are all set for action to get underway! The umpires are out in the middle. The players have made their way out as well. All the players will take the knee in support of the BLM movement. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers will open the batting for West Indies. Mohammed Siraj will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

Yuzvendra Chahal is down for a chat. He says that they have a young team, but all the players have played in the Indian T20 League and they have a bit of experience. Mentions that they had three medium-pace bowlers so they decided to play spin later on in the innings in the first game, which he loved to do. Further says that close games in ODIs are very exciting.

Shikhar Dhawan the captain of India says that it's a very good wicket once again, but once the spinners come into play it becomes a little slow. Mentions that they want to improve in their fielding department and also a slight improvement in their bowling is also needed.  Adds that he was very pleased with the previous games, Mohammed Siraj and Prasidh Krishna bowled well and he says that they are confident of doing well today as well. Informs that Prasidh Krishna makes way for Avesh Khan who is set to make his debut.

Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies says that they are going to bat first, it's the same wicket as the first ODI and anything over 250 will be challenging. Mentions that they need to step up with the bat and build partnerships and execute their plans. Informs that they have one forced change, Gudakesh Motie is out and Hayden Walsh is in. On Shai Hope, he says that he should his 100th ODI game.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Shubman Gill, Shreyas Iyer, Suryakumar Yadav, Sanju Samson (WK), Deepak Hooda, Axar Patel, Shardul Thakur, Yuzvendra Chahal, Mohammed Siraj, Avesh Khan (On debut) (In for Prasidh Krishna).

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Brandon King, Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Akeal Hosein, Romario Shepherd, Alzarri Joseph, Jayden Seales, Hayden Walsh (In for Gudakesh Motie).
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!
The news from the middle is that Avesh Khan has received his ODI cap and he is all set to make his debut!
